headline: Cornerstone Insurance Reaches Agreement to Merge With AIICO Insurance
summary: Cornerstone Plc reached an agreement to merge with AIICO Insurance, combining businesses with approximately ₦194 billion in shareholders' funds and ₦858 billion in total assets.
why: Insurance sector consolidation alters market share dynamics and balance sheet strength for major financial institutions in West Africa.

impacts.name: Cornerstone Plc
impacts.why: The company is participating in a major merger.
